feature.purpose: Show personalized and exploratory manga candidates grouped by eligible source.
feature.states: loading loaded partial empty recoverable-error
feature.constraints: language genre minimum-chapters exclusions source-eligibility personalized-majority exposure-window
feature.privacy: Evaluation mode replaces source names with neutral labels. Manga artwork, titles, and recommendation context remain visible.

feature.purpose: Present combined top matches and export or import a validated recommendation set.
feature.states: loaded partial export-chooser import-review invalid library-add-result
feature.privacy: Recommendation bundles can contain selected manga and source information. Evaluation mode does not anonymize the exported file.

feature.purpose: Load related manga for a rated or linked group through bounded, independent source rows.
feature.states: loading partial loaded row-timeout row-error cancelled
feature.privacy: Evaluation mode replaces source names, not account or device details. Check manga context and the whole screen before sharing.

feature.purpose: Find and change recommendation settings by section or search.
feature.states: loaded search filtered
feature.privacy: Settings can reveal source choices and taste preferences. Check the visible values before sharing.

feature.purpose: Evaluate source suitability and disclose partial, skipped, failed, and reassessment outcomes.
feature.states: ready running partial completed cancelled failed
feature.privacy: Copied diagnostics use error categories instead of raw errors. Source and extension names can remain when Evaluation mode is off.

feature.purpose: Explain rating-derived taste signals, source-quality observations, and recovery actions.
feature.states: summary history limited-evidence marked cleared
feature.privacy: Taste and quality diagnostics can show tags, source choices, and manga context. Neutral display labels do not hide every detail.

feature.purpose: Suggest compatible non-installed sources using taste and source-evaluation signals.
feature.states: loading suggestions empty unavailable install-handoff
feature.privacy: Evaluation mode replaces source names with neutral labels; suggestions can still reveal taste preferences.

feature.purpose: Treat Love, Like, Dislike, and Not Interested as peer preference actions with reversible transitions.
feature.states: neutral loved liked disliked not-interested
feature.privacy: Manga artwork, titles, and ratings remain visible. Evaluation mode changes source labels only where supported.

feature.purpose: Find, select, link, group, and compare versions through guarded source work.
feature.states: searching candidates selected linked empty partial-failure
feature.privacy: Matching results show manga titles and artwork. Evaluation mode can replace source labels, but does not anonymize the result.

feature.purpose: Compare chapters and page previews, open a selected chapter with View in Reader even if previews fail, or choose Migrate, Copy, or Cancel after selecting another version.
feature.states: loading comparable insufficient-data preview-failed reader-open comparison-returned keep-current confirmed cancelled failed
feature.privacy: Chapter names, manga artwork, previews, and reader pages remain visible. Evaluation mode is not a way to hide reading content.

feature.purpose: Apply optional timer and schedule policy, defer completion rating until exit, and preserve ordinary reader navigation.
feature.states: allowed restricted grace completed deferred-prompt
feature.privacy: Reader pages and progress are private content.

feature.purpose: Remember status, score, dates, and integer or decimal chapter progress without an external tracking account; apply saved progress on load or refresh and share it across confirmed versions when enabled.
feature.states: untracked tracked edited progress-applied sharing-disabled conflict
feature.privacy: Local progress and linked manga are saved on the device. External-account reconciliation is a separate user action; sharing local progress does not change tracker accounts.

feature.purpose: Switch either way between an active pair of manga sources; suggest the same or closest available chapter and let the reader review chapter names and translation-group labels before opening it.
feature.states: choosing-source choosing-chapter reading-primary reading-alternate unavailable cancelled
feature.privacy: Reader pages, chapter choices, and progress remain visible. Switching does not automatically add the other manga to the library; reading can update saved progress.

feature.purpose: Move the chapter list to the resolved last-read position without changing chapter state.
feature.states: available unavailable scrolled
feature.privacy: Chapter names and reading position are private history.

feature.purpose: Replace source, repository, extension, and tag names with neutral display labels without changing saved data, actions, or network behavior.
feature.states: disabled enabled
feature.privacy: Neutral display labels do not hide manga titles, artwork, account details, notifications, or every part of Android.

feature.purpose: Disclose reversible and non-reversible actions and restore supported local state when no conflict exists.
feature.states: empty entries undoable conflict restored non-reversible
feature.privacy: Action history can reveal recorded choices. Undo is available only for supported local changes without a conflict.

feature.purpose: Export selected extensions to a chosen document location. Successful exports are kept; identified incomplete exports can offer Keep or Remove. Development builds can also offer removal after success.
feature.states: ready chooser success cancelled failed cleanup-kept cleanup-removed cleanup-failed
feature.privacy: Exported extension files can identify installed packages. A confirmation screen does not anonymize the chosen file or document location.

feature.purpose: Index and search recognized text from downloaded chapter pages on the device.
feature.states: no-index indexing searchable partial cancelled failed
feature.privacy: Recognized page text and search results can reveal reading content. OCR text stays local and is excluded from backup and sync.

feature.purpose: Back up selected Komikku FC ratings, recommendation preferences, links, source evaluations, and local tracking alongside ordinary library data; restore supported items with partial-failure reporting.
feature.states: selected encoded restored partial failed
feature.privacy: Backups can include selected library, reading, tracking, and account settings. Check the backup options and keep the file private.

feature.purpose: Report recoverable extension failures and perform installation, removal, and export using supported methods. Fatal crashes are not guaranteed to be contained.
feature.states: ready consent success cancelled failed cleanup-verified
feature.privacy: Installed package, repository, source, and document-provider details may identify user configuration.

feature.purpose: Validate external inputs, isolate ordinary failures, preserve cancellation, and scope local mutations and cleanup.
feature.states: accepted rejected isolated-failure cancelled verified-mutation
feature.privacy: Opening a link or passing a source check is not proof of trust. Check files and logs before sharing private route information.

feature.purpose: Show current and historical Komikku FC changes separately from upstream Komikku release notes.
feature.states: current-family collapsed-family expanded-family acknowledged
feature.privacy: The change history describes public Komikku FC releases; check surrounding screen and system information before sharing.
